correctness.rationale: A standalone exact checker reconstructs all 11 perfect matchings and 495 faces, replays all 242 free-face collapses and proves the residual graph is a 5-cycle. It computes signed simplex traces 2,0,2 for row/column/combined reflections, so the connected S1 character is -1,+1,-1. Rational quotient homology follows from exact invariants for finite groups; no claims beyond the finite grid are made.

value.rationale: The three-by-four Cartesian grid is the first nondegenerate three-row even-width rectangular instance beyond the complete two-row theorem, selected by the explicit all-grid conjecture. The 242-step exact collapse decides its integral homotopy type, and the full reflection-sign module and contrasting quotients are natural equivariant invariants not implied by any sphere-bouquet conjecture. This is an exact meaningful finite boundary case, not a routine parameter renaming.
